1722-2034-3583-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6097.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

116-512-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
116-512-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-647-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3129-5254-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-5254-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
3129-5254-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-5944-8095.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

728-772-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

215-3043-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-6633.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-3742-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6152.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Veteran Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7175-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

296-2350-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-2350-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5733-6122-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-6122-6991.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Donnie & April from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
5733-6122-6991.notes: If you cast Donnie & April from the command zone to start, you must be able to pay for commander tax that first turn.

1978-3263-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
1978-3263-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat

67-1676-5670-6823-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6823-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Aunt May and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Aunt May triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6823-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

38-2173-5220-6094.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2173-5220-6885--134.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2034-2173-5220-6885--134.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Vampire with mana value 1 or less, adding {C}{C}.
When the Vampire dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the Vampire from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the Vampire from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Activate Anje by paying {2} life and sacrificing the Vampire.
When the Vampire dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the Vampire from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Anje ability, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

292-3334-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3334-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1497-2713-4949-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate an ability of a creature.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5559.notablePrerequisites:
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to create a token copy of Nazgûl.
1636-3143-5559.description:
Create a token copy of Nazgûl.
When the Nazgûl token enters the battlefield, its first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Nazgûl trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you.
Each Nazgûl's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each Wraith you control.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of the Nazgûl token.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-3143-5559.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Wraiths you control, you can instead create copies of any other creature token(s) you control.

2525-2947-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Double, adding {R}.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.

628-2511-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2511-5490.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-678-2060-2123-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
413-678-2060-2123-4017.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Kokusho enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

567-1462-2232-2413-2768.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
567-1462-2232-2413-2768.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Soul's Attendant trigger that many times.
Resolve all Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the number of creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more nontoken creatures, this combo nets infinite life.

868-3044-3105-4285.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual.
Cast Pyretic Ritual.
Cast Ill-Gotten Gains.
Cast Increasing Vengeance targeting Ill-Gotten Gains.
With the Ill-Gotten Gains copy return the other three cards to your hand.
Repeat.

1167-1384.description:
Use Mindslaver's ability targeting an opponent.
Activate Academy Ruins's ability targeting Mindslaver in graveyard.
Pass to opponent's turn.
Pass to your turn and draw Mindslaver.
Play Mindslaver, use it, and target it with Academy Ruins.

1295-2853.description:
Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library, preventing the next one damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Repeat step 1 until there are no cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield winning you the game.

65-717-2628-4371-4652.description:
Activate Irrigated Farmland's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Irrigated Farmland, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Irrigated Farmland trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Irrigated Farmland and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
